# Neeraj Rekwar - Portfolio & Blog

Neeraj Rekwar is a Full Stack Developer & Creator specializing in Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and modern web development.
This website serves as his personal portfolio, blog, and contact portal.

## Profile & Vision
Neeraj turns complex problems into elegant solutions. He is a passionate Programmer and Entrepreneur.
He focuses on building modern web experiences with high performance and accessibility in mind.
